title: Kepler to Müller, 13/23 November 1629
author: Johannes Kepler
summary: Kepler thanks Müller for arranging his type and paper, and pours out his distress over a rival suitor, a secretary of the Margrave of Baden, who is pressing for his daughter Susanna's hand while her betrothed Jacob Bartsch is away.

notes.note: Kepler's marginal note here, on the weight of the Cicero type, has signs the 1927 printing shows unclearly: the fraction of a hundredweight is perhaps ½, and the accent signs and the two star signs in the German postscript are approximated.
A size of type, about 12 point, named after early editions of Cicero printed in it.
Matthias Bernegger, professor at Strasbourg and Kepler's friend, in whose care Susanna was living there. Kepler writes *Pernegger*.
A smaller size of type, about 10 point, named after the French punchcutter Claude Garamond.
